english.note: Use 工人 as the all-purpose term for a person who works, especially a manual worker.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone employed for wages, especially in manual work.
Use this for a worker or laborer, especially someone hired for manual work.

examples.english: My dad has been a construction worker for decades.
examples.traditional: 我阿爸做咗幾十年地盤工人。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 dei6 pun4 gung1 jan4

examples.english: We hired a workman to help us move house.
examples.traditional: 我哋請咗個工人幫手搬屋。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 gung1 jan4 bong1 sau2 bun1 uk1

examples.english: This worker is a good hand at renovation.
examples.traditional: 呢個工人係裝修嘅好手。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 jan4 hai6 zong1 sau1 ge3 hou2 sau2

english.note: Use 工人 as the everyday all-purpose term for a paid household worker, especially a domestic helper.
Use this in Hong Kong household contexts for a domestic helper, not for a worker in general.

examples.english: Our servant cooks and cleans for us every day.
examples.traditional: 我屋企個工人每日都幫我哋煮飯同執屋。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 gung1 jan4 mui5 jat6 dou1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zyu2 faan6 tung4 zap1 uk1

examples.english: We hired a domestic help for our home.
